source_configurations.eligibility_note: Good or Moderate JBI, eligible ratio effect, total sample size required; exact cases optional; automated summaries use one primary estimate per study context, and forest summaries require at least two studies per exposure.
Current combined parent cancer Summary; source quality, hierarchy and pooling exclusions retained.
Good or Moderate JBI and an eligible ratio effect; no minimum case count. Forest summaries require at least two studies per exposure.

Good or Moderate JBI and an eligible ratio effect. Counts are extraction estimates, including separate sex or measurement strata; forest summaries require at least two estimates per exposure. N and case totals sum estimates and may overlap across strata.

Good or Moderate JBI and an eligible ratio effect. Counts and sample sizes use the same selected estimates as the hierarchy view. Correlated exposures from the same article are not pooled together; forest summaries require at least two estimates per exposure.
Good or Moderate JBI, eligible ratio effect, total sample size required; exact cases optional; forest summaries require at least two studies per exposure.

Incidence endpoint only; Good or Moderate JBI, reported Outcome Type must be OR, HR, RR, IRR, or RRR and agree with the canonical Effect Type, the positive 95% CI must contain the estimate, and total sample size required; exact cases optional are required; forest summaries require at least two studies per exposure.

overlap_policy: Site/histology/age/molecular mappings and parent rollups do not create additional participants or expenditure; preserve one report/cohort/comparison identity.
sarcoma_behavior_policy: Keep requested vocabulary including DFSP/infantile fibrosarcoma/ALT for discovery, but do not automatically include benign or intermediate behavior as malignant; unresolved behavior remains review.
